comments: Evaluates PDF documents locally (zero server uploads) against ISO 14289-1 (PDF/UA-1), ISO 14289-2 (PDF/UA-2), Matterhorn Protocol 1.1 checkpoints, and machine-verifiable WCAG 2.2 criteria using embedded veraPDF 1.30.4. Core single-PDF evaluation, canvas highlighting, and simulated screen reader preview are permanently free (plus an optional zero-upload browser pre-checker at https://lektpdf.com/).
features: Offline macOS and Windows evaluation tool for testing PDF documents against WCAG 2.2, ISO 14289-1 (PDF/UA-1), and ISO 14289-2 (PDF/UA-2) via embedded veraPDF. Provides clause-level diagnostics, canvas bounding-box inspection, tag tree and simulated screen reader order preview, batch folder audits, and CSV/JSON/HTML reports.
